# Luxen Digital

> Luxen Digital builds premium websites and AI-powered business systems for local service businesses — a high-converting website, CRM, automated follow-up, reviews, and AI in one system that helps a business capture and convert more leads. No long-term contracts.

Plans start at $99/month. Contact: team@luxendigital.com · +1 (858) 223-9635.

## Services

- [Lead-Generating Website](https://luxendigital.com/services/lead-generating-website): A custom, fast, conversion-focused website for service businesses
- [Get Found in Search and AI](https://luxendigital.com/services/get-found-in-search-and-ai): Local search and AI visibility — rank in Google map results and get named by ChatGPT or Gemini
- [Stay in Touch](https://luxendigital.com/services/stay-in-touch): Seasonal reminders and offers that bring past customers back
- [Missed Call Text Back](https://luxendigital.com/services/missed-call-text-back): Every missed call gets an instant text back
- [All-in-One Inbox](https://luxendigital.com/services/all-in-one-inbox): Texts, emails, calls, and social messages in one shared inbox
- [Business Phone](https://luxendigital.com/services/business-phone): A dedicated business number that rings the phone you already carry
- [Automatic Follow-Up](https://luxendigital.com/services/automatic-follow-up): Timed text and email follow-up on every lead and quote until they book
- [More 5-Star Reviews](https://luxendigital.com/services/more-5-star-reviews): Automatic review requests at the moment customers are happiest
